outcomes.source: sealed IC Markets MT5 XAUUSD one-minute source
outcomes.start: close of exact complete bar [decision_at-1m, decision_at) with available_at <= decision_at
outcomes.endpoint: close of Hth exact complete subsequent bar in [decision_at, decision_at+H)
outcomes.missing_policy: retain the frozen anchor and mark the affected horizon UNKNOWN; no gap skipping, interpolation, imputation, substitute provider, or later bar
outcomes.primary_metadata_readiness: per session require at least 80% anchor completeness, 150 dates, 30 blocks, each validation fold at least 35 dates and 480 anchors, and at least 80% of each frozen OOF-year date universe
outcomes.test_specific_primary_outcome_coverage: apply the same gates after intersecting the frozen predictor or interaction availability with valid 15m outcomes; failure is INCONCLUSIVE_OUTCOME_COVERAGE

test_specific_primary_outcome_coverage_g.annual_denominator: frozen predictor-eligible or interaction-joint-eligible OOF session dates in that year

outcomes.diagnostic_horizon_missingness: reported as UNKNOWN and excluded only from that diagnostic; never a primary pass gate and never a rescue

transform.scale: unscaled MAD, then population standard deviation only if MAD is zero

stage1.coefficient_gate: Huber slope has registered expected sign in every fold

stage2.model: closed-form hierarchical ridge main effects plus registered interaction
stage2.primary_score: registered interaction score after training-only input transforms
stage2.comparison: separately fitted main-effects ridge under the identical fold
stage2.interaction_coefficient_gate: interaction slope has registered expected sign in every fold

bootstrap.method: fixed full-OOF average ranks with resampled-block weighted rank correlation and accuracy lift

permutation.method: permute complete outcome date vectors within validation fold and identical anchor-offset signature

seed.derivation: base seed is the first eight SHA-256 bytes, big-endian unsigned, of GC_CSR_V3_M3|session|stage|test_id|method; each horizon permutation sub-seed is the first eight SHA-256 bytes, big-endian unsigned, of base_seed|Hhorizon

multiplicity.primary: Benjamini-Hochberg separately by session and stage across every support-eligible test
multiplicity.technical_inconclusive_in_bh_family: retain the preregistered family member with p=1.0 rather than shrinking the family
multiplicity.diagnostic_horizons: Holm across 5m, 30m, and 60m within test; descriptive only

status_rules.PASS: every frozen primary and stage-specific gate passes
status_rules.REJECT: technical gates pass but one or more relationship/robustness gates fail
status_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: only preregistered outcome coverage, model convergence/degeneracy, or finite-resampling technical failure
status_rules.SUPPORT_FAIL: preserved outcome-blind M2-R1 disposition; no outcome calculation

reproduction.outcome_arithmetic: independent native-float and Decimal parses compared at fixed-point scale
